correctness.rationale: The graph is explicitly given by 30 pentagonal-belt edges. Exhaustive checking of its 4095 nonempty subsets gives exactly 323 allowed simplices with f-vector (12,66,140,105). A fixed-pivot matching has 147 pairs and is acyclic across all 972 Hasse covers, leaving 1 critical 0-cell, 4 critical 2-cells and 24 critical 3-cells. The exact signed Morse boundary contains a 4x4 minor of determinant +1, hence surjects over the integers. Its 20-dimensional kernel is free; the 3-dimensional CW model is simply connected and has zero \(H_2\), so Hurewicz and Whitehead prove a wedge of 20 copies of \(S^3\). Direct independent mod-two simplicial ranks 11,55,85 agree. The certificate and full replay program are embedded.

value.rationale: This determines a natural unknown exact higher-independence invariant of the unique 5-regular Platonic triangulation, beyond standard graph-family classifications. It supplies the entire integral homotopy type and 2-connectivity, not just homology or face counts. As a canonical short highly symmetric test case for P3-devoid and forest-filtration topology, its explicit integral attaching map is a meaningful homotopical computation. The claim remains appropriately narrow: no family or equivariant statement is implied.
